fficients were not clean, so it is not a recognisable closed form.

The data suggest a P·lnP term (Gompertz-like growth), a negative time-only term that grows roughly like √t or t·ln t, and some time–density interaction. Further work would need a different sampling of t at fixed P to separate these.

best.code:
import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    r = params[0] + params[1]*t
    lnK = params[2] + params[3]*t
    return r*P*(lnK - np.log(P)) + params[4]*t + params[5]*t**2 + params[6]*t*np.log(t) + params[7]*t*P
